Control the dinosaur with hand gestures via your webcam:

- **Open palm** ✋ — jump
- **Closed fist** ✊ — duck (hold)
- **Thumbs up** 👍 — restart after a crash

```{=html}
<div class="trex-host">
  <div id="main-frame-error" class="interstitial-wrapper">
    <div id="main-content">
      <div class="icon icon-offline" alt=""></div>
    </div>
    <div id="offline-resources">
      <img id="offline-resources-1x" src="trex/assets/default_100_percent/100-offline-sprite.png">
      <img id="offline-resources-2x" src="trex/assets/default_200_percent/200-offline-sprite.png">
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="nui-panel">
  <button id="nui-start" type="button">Start camera</button>
  <div class="nui-feed">
    <video id="nui-video" playsinline muted></video>
    <div class="nui-overlay">
      <span id="nui-gesture">—</span>
      <span id="nui-status">Camera off</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
  .trex-host {
    position: relative;
    width: 600px;
    height: 150px;
    margin: 1.5rem auto 0.5rem;
    background: #f7f7f7;
  }
  .trex-host #offline-resources,
  .trex-host #main-content,
  .trex-host .icon { display: none; }
  .trex-host .interstitial-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }
  .trex-host .runner-container {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
  }
  .trex-host .runner-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    image-rendering: pixelated;
  }

  .nui-panel {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin: 0.5rem auto 2rem;
  }
  #nui-start {
    padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    border: 1px solid #888;
    background: #f4f4f4;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #nui-start:hover { background: #e8e8e8; }
  .nui-feed {
    position: relative;
    width: 280px;
    height: 210px;
    background: #111;
    border-radius: 6px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #nui-video {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    transform: scaleX(-1);
  }
  .nui-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    inset: auto 0 0 0;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
    color: #fff;
    font: 600 12px/1.2 monospace;
  }
</style>

<script src="trex/trex-runner.js"></script>

<script type="module">
  const MP_VERSION = "0.10.35";
  let GestureRecognizer, FilesetResolver;
  try {
    ({ GestureRecognizer, FilesetResolver } = await import(
      `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@${MP_VERSION}/vision_bundle.mjs`
    ));
  } catch (err) {
    document.getElementById('nui-status').textContent = 'Load failed: ' + err.message;
    console.error('MediaPipe import failed', err);
    throw err;
  }

  const video    = document.getElementById('nui-video');
  const startBtn = document.getElementById('nui-start');
  const gestureEl = document.getElementById('nui-gesture');
  const statusEl  = document.getElementById('nui-status');

  const KEY = { JUMP: 32, DUCK: 40, RESTART: 13 };
  const JUMP_COOLDOWN_MS = 280;

  let recognizer = null;
  let lastVideoTime = -1;
  let lastGesture = 'None';
  let duckHeld = false;
  let lastJumpAt = 0;

  // Drive the game directly via its onKeyDown/onKeyUp methods. Synthetic
  // KeyboardEvents are unreliable because the t-rex-runner reads the
  // deprecated e.keyCode, and Firefox shadows defineProperty overrides on
  // KeyboardEvent instances with the prototype getter.
  function fireKey(type, keyCode) {
    const runner = window.Runner && window.Runner.instance_;
    if (!runner) return;
    const evt = { keyCode, type, target: document, preventDefault() {} };
    if (type === 'keydown') runner.onKeyDown(evt);
    else if (type === 'keyup') runner.onKeyUp(evt);
  }
  function tapKey(keyCode) {
    fireKey('keydown', keyCode);
    setTimeout(() => fireKey('keyup', keyCode), 60);
  }
  function setDuck(active) {
    if (active && !duckHeld)       { fireKey('keydown', KEY.DUCK); duckHeld = true; }
    else if (!active && duckHeld)  { fireKey('keyup',   KEY.DUCK); duckHeld = false; }
  }
  function tryJump() {
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - lastJumpAt < JUMP_COOLDOWN_MS) return;
    lastJumpAt = now;
    tapKey(KEY.JUMP);
  }

  function handleGesture(g) {
    gestureEl.textContent = g;
    // Edge-triggered actions on gesture transitions
    if (g !== lastGesture) {
      if (g === 'Open_Palm') tryJump();
      if (g === 'Thumb_Up')  tapKey(KEY.RESTART);
    }
    setDuck(g === 'Closed_Fist');
    lastGesture = g;
  }

  function loop() {
    if (video.readyState >= 2 && video.currentTime !== lastVideoTime) {
      lastVideoTime = video.currentTime;
      const res = recognizer.recognizeForVideo(video, performance.now());
      const g = (res.gestures && res.gestures.length) ? res.gestures[0][0].categoryName : 'None';
      handleGesture(g);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  async function start() {
    startBtn.disabled = true;
    statusEl.textContent = 'Requesting camera…';
    try {
      // Camera first while the click's user-activation is still fresh — Firefox
      // can reject getUserMedia with NotAllowedError after a long await chain.
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { width: 320, height: 240, facingMode: 'user' },
        audio: false
      });
      video.srcObject = stream;
      await video.play();

      statusEl.textContent = 'Loading model…';
      const vision = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(
        `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@${MP_VERSION}/wasm`
      );
      recognizer = await GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(vision, {
        baseOptions: {
          modelAssetPath: "https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/gesture_recognizer/gesture_recognizer/float16/latest/gesture_recognizer.task",
          delegate: "CPU"
        },
        runningMode: "VIDEO",
        numHands: 1
      });
      statusEl.textContent = 'Tracking';
      startBtn.style.display = 'none';
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      let msg = err.message || String(err);
      if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError') {
        msg = window.isSecureContext
          ? 'Camera permission denied — allow it in the site settings.'
          : 'Insecure context — open via http://localhost (e.g. `quarto preview`), not file:// or a LAN IP.';
      } else if (err.name === 'NotFoundError') {
        msg = 'No camera device found.';
      }
      statusEl.textContent = msg;
      startBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  startBtn.addEventListener('click', start);
</script>
```
